task: Classify local tumor extent in esophageal carcinoma. Classes: Early_T vs. Advanced_T. Distinguishing H&E features include superficial versus deeply infiltrative growth, extent of stromal desmoplasia, and architectural destruction of the esophageal wall.

classes.0: Early_T tumor showing relatively superficial invasion and more limited disruption of native esophageal architecture.
classes.1: Advanced_T tumor showing deep infiltrative invasion with extensive wall destruction and desmoplastic response.
